title: Endogenous opioid dynamics in the dorsal striatum sculpt neural activity to promote goal-directed action.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: paper_context.py: Cell paper not open access, no PMCID, no supplement, no GEO/SRA/BioProject links, only an antibody RRID text-mined, Zenodo/Dryad DOI search empty. One web search found no Zenodo or DANDI (neurophysiology archive) deposit. Read the first third of the bioRxiv preprint (10.1101/2024.05.20.595035); no data availability statement in that part.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: About 14,083 tracked neurons from two-photon imaging in roughly 4 mice; behavioural cohorts of 2-12 mice per group (preprint text, not files).

a1_downloadable.note: No public data deposit found (no PMC entry, no repository links, no Zenodo/DANDI hit); paywalled Cell paper, so the data statement can't be read. Checked repositories only, opened no files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Mouse imaging and optogenetics experiments; any label (lever press, learning phase) would have to be built from raw calcium traces and behaviour logs. Not a column in any table.

a5_enough_rows.note: About 14,083 neurons, but only from about 4 mice (from the preprint); the number of independent animals is tiny.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Raw two-photon movies would be many GB; processed traces aren't published.

a8_label_provenance.note: Behaviour would be a physical measurement, but it has not been released.

honest_claim_h3: None: no released data, so no model claim is possible.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use striatal neuron calcium activity recorded in mice to predict when the animal performs a learned reward-seeking action.
plain_idea.train_on: Activity traces from about 14,083 imaged neurons in about 4 mice, as the preprint describes; no files have been released.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a lever press or reward-seeking action happens, taken from the operant chamber's behaviour logs.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Little value: decoding behaviour from neurons in a few mice is routine, and the paper's real contribution is causal experiments, not data a model can reuse.

ml_idea: Decode actions from two-photon population activity. Not viable: no data deposit, about 4 mice, and the label would have to be built from raw traces.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Search DANDI for the lead authors' names; if nothing is there, the project is dead.

verdict_reason: Paywalled mouse neuroscience paper with no public data deposit found. The label would have to be built from raw imaging, the experiments cover only about 4 mice, and there's no ML-ready table.
